social.title: See a Touring Act at Asheville Yards Amphitheater
social.description: Grab a spot on the lawn of South Slope's 3,500-capacity outdoor amphitheater for a national touring show with a taco truck and cold beer within reach.
social.bonus: Make a new friend in the lawn section before the headliner comes on

social.title: See a National Act at The Orange Peel
social.description: Pack into one of Rolling Stone's top-rated rock clubs in the country for a touring show under a sprung dance floor built for a crowd.
social.bonus: Get to the rail before the opener starts

social.title: Play Trivia Night at Foggy Mountain Brewpub
social.description: Grab a pitcher and stake a claim to a table at a downtown brewpub's weekly trivia night, elbow to elbow with regulars.
social.bonus: Recruit a stranger to join your trivia team

social.title: Catch a Show at The Grey Eagle in the River Arts District
social.description: Squeeze into a beloved Americana and rock venue that's booked touring acts and local favorites since 1994.
social.bonus: Talk to a stranger about the opening act

social.title: Watch the Skyline from Capella on 9 Rooftop Bar
social.description: Order a round on a ninth-floor terrace where downtown Asheville's rooftops give way to a wall of mountains at golden hour.
social.bonus: Time your first drink to hit the rail right at sunset

social.title: Catch Live Music at Pisgah Brewing Company
social.description: Grab a lawn chair at a Black Mountain taproom stage that's hosted jam bands and bluegrass pickers for two decades.
social.bonus: Learn one dance move from whoever's dancing near the stage

social.title: Ride the Purple Bus on the LaZoom Comedy Tour
social.description: Climb aboard a bright purple bus for an hour of live stand-up, local lore, and unhinged sightseeing through downtown Asheville.
social.bonus: Volunteer for whatever bit the comedian needs a passenger for

social.title: Join the Friday Night Drum Circle at Pritchard Park
social.description: Bring a hand drum or just your hips to a decades-old downtown tradition where hundreds gather to dance as the sun goes down.
social.bonus: Dance in the circle for at least one full song

social.title: Play Ping Pong Over Ramen at Ben's Tune Up
social.description: Split a bowl of ramen and challenge a friend to ping pong at Asheville's only sake brewery, tucked under string lights on Hilliard Avenue.
social.bonus: Challenge the next table to a ping pong match

social.title: Order a Round of Craft Cocktails at Sovereign Remedies
social.description: Settle into a warm, eclectic downtown bar for herb-forward cocktails and late-night small plates that outlast the dinner crowd.
social.bonus: Order whatever cocktail the bartender likes best

chill.title: Gallery-Hop Through Wedge Studios in the River Arts District
chill.description: Wander four floors of open working studios inside a converted RAD warehouse where potters, painters, and printmakers work in plain sight.
chill.bonus: Talk to one artist about the piece they're working on

chill.title: Play Unlimited Pinball at the Asheville Pinball Museum
chill.description: Pay one flat admission and work a room of vintage arcade cabinets and pinball machines dating back to the 1930s for as long as you want.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest machine in the room and play it first

chill.title: Wander the Bonsai Garden at the North Carolina Arboretum
chill.description: Follow quiet forest paths past a world-class bonsai collection and quilt garden spread across 434 mountain acres.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest-looking bonsai in the collection

chill.title: Get Lost for an Hour at Malaprop's Bookstore/Cafe
chill.description: Browse floor-to-ceiling shelves of an independent bookstore that's anchored downtown Asheville's literary scene since 1982, latte in hand.
chill.bonus: Buy the book with the title that intrigues you most

chill.title: Sip Champagne Among the Stacks at Battery Park Book Exchange
chill.description: Curl into a leather armchair with a used novel and a glass of bubbly inside a bookstore built into a converted 1920s hotel lobby.
chill.bonus: Order the wine flight and pick your favorite pour

chill.title: Spend an Afternoon Inside the Asheville Art Museum
chill.description: Move slowly through galleries of 20th and 21st-century American art in a light-filled building right on Pack Square.
chill.bonus: Pick your favorite piece and explain why to whoever you're with

chill.title: Stroll the Native Plant Paths at Botanical Gardens at Asheville
chill.description: Wander ten free acres of Southern Appalachian wildflowers and ferns tucked right behind UNC Asheville's campus.
chill.bonus: Name three plants you've never seen before

chill.title: Tour Biltmore Estate and Taste Wine at Antler Hill Village
chill.description: Wander America's largest private home room by room, then walk the gardens down to a working winery for a free tasting flight.
chill.bonus: Pick the one room in the house you'd actually want to live in

chill.title: Watch the Sunset from the Grove Park Inn's Sunset Terrace
chill.description: Settle into a rocking chair on a century-old stone terrace as the Blue Ridge Mountains turn pink behind a glass of wine.
chill.bonus: Stay in the rocking chair until the last color fades from the ridgeline

chill.title: Watch Live Craft Demos at the Folk Art Center
chill.description: Catch a weaver or woodturner working in real time at the Southern Highland Craft Guild's Blue Ridge Parkway gallery.
chill.bonus: Ask a demonstrating artist how long they've practiced their craft

chill.title: Unwind on the Patio at Hi-Wire Brewing's Big Top
chill.description: Settle into a lawn chair with a hazy IPA in a sprawling beer garden a half mile from the Biltmore gates.
chill.bonus: Try the flight instead of committing to one beer

chill.title: Browse the Historic Grove Arcade Shops
chill.description: Duck into a 1929 gothic-revival market hall packed with independent jewelers, potters, and a champagne-and-books bar under one ornate roof.
chill.bonus: Buy something handmade from a local maker

adventure.title: Mountain Bike the Singletrack at Bent Creek Experimental Forest
adventure.description: Rip through 30 miles of flowy, well-signed singletrack twenty minutes from downtown, built for everything from first laps to fast climbs.
adventure.bonus: Ride one trail you've never taken before

adventure.title: Hike to the Towering Hickory Nut Falls
adventure.description: Follow a forested ridge trail inside Chimney Rock State Park to the base of one of North Carolina's tallest waterfalls.
adventure.bonus: Guess the waterfall's height before reading the sign

adventure.title: Throw a Round of Disc Golf at Richmond Hill Park
adventure.description: Work an 18-basket course through 180 wooded acres above the French Broad River, with skyline views between every throw.
adventure.bonus: Bet your playing partner a drink on the next hole

adventure.title: Run the French Broad Gorge with French Broad Adventures
adventure.description: Paddle hard through Class II-III whitewater in a rowdy gorge outside Marshall, then float the calm stretch soaking in Pisgah National Forest cliffs.
adventure.bonus: Volunteer to sit in the front row of the raft

adventure.title: Kayak the French Broad Past the Biltmore Estate
adventure.description: Paddle a self-guided calm-water route that drifts beneath the Biltmore's forested bluffs before landing in the River Arts District.
adventure.bonus: Wave at the next boat that passes

adventure.title: Watch the Sun Set from the Max Patch Bald
adventure.description: Climb a grassy Appalachian Trail summit stripped bare of trees and watch the ridgelines turn gold in every direction at once.
adventure.bonus: Stay until the first star appears before hiking down

adventure.title: Ride the Paved Loop at Carrier Park
adventure.description: Spin laps on a riverside bike path past a skate park and disc golf course, with the French Broad running alongside the whole way.
adventure.bonus: Do one lap faster than the one before it

adventure.title: Zipline the Canopy Tour with French Broad Adventures
adventure.description: Clip into a line and soar through a series of treetop ziplines above the French Broad River gorge outside Marshall.
adventure.bonus: Go first on the longest line of the course

adventure.title: Paddle a Quiet Loop Around Lake Powhatan
adventure.description: Glide a canoe across a still forest lake tucked inside Bent Creek Experimental Forest, twenty minutes from downtown traffic.
adventure.bonus: Paddle to the far shore and just float for five minutes

adventure.title: Chase the Cascades on the Catawba Falls Trail
adventure.description: Follow a rushing mountain creek past a series of tiered waterfalls to the thundering upper falls outside Old Fort.
adventure.bonus: Dip your feet in the creek at the lower falls

adventure.title: Summit Devil's Courthouse for a Four-State View
adventure.description: Power up a steep half-mile paved climb to a rocky overlook where Georgia, Tennessee, South Carolina, and North Carolina all spread out at once.
adventure.bonus: Name all four states before checking a map

adventure.title: Waterfall-Hop Triple Falls and Hooker Falls in DuPont Forest
adventure.description: Wander a rolling forest trail linking three separate waterfalls, including one famous enough to have appeared in The Hunger Games.
adventure.bonus: Find the spot where Katniss camped on screen

adventure.title: Float the French Broad on a Zen Tubing Run
adventure.description: Drift lazy-river style down the French Broad River on an oversized tube while the Blue Ridge foothills roll by overhead.
adventure.bonus: Race the tube next to you to the takeout point

adventure.title: Hike the Craggy Pinnacle Trail on the Blue Ridge Parkway
adventure.description: Climb a short, steep mile through wind-bent rhododendron tunnels to a 360-degree summit view above Craggy Gardens.
adventure.bonus: Spot the exact moment the Parkway disappears into cloud

adventure.title: Throw a Bowl on the Wheel at Odyssey Clayworks
adventure.description: Get your hands muddy learning to center clay on a pottery wheel at a working River Arts District ceramics studio.
adventure.bonus: Name the piece you make before it comes out of the kiln

adventure.title: Ride the Elevator to the Top of Chimney Rock
adventure.description: Ascend a 315-foot granite monolith for a sweeping view of Lake Lure and Hickory Nut Gorge stretched out below.
adventure.bonus: Count how many waterfalls you can spot from the top

adventure.title: Run the French Broad River Greenway
adventure.description: Log miles along a flat riverside path that hugs the French Broad past Carrier Park, mountains visible the entire route.
adventure.bonus: Push your pace for the last half mile

adventure.title: Paddle a Kayak Around Lake Julian Park
adventure.description: Launch a rented kayak onto a calm 30-acre lake ringed by walking trails just south of downtown.
adventure.bonus: Paddle to the far side of the lake and back without stopping

adventure.title: Boulder a New Route at ClimbMax Climbing Downtown
adventure.description: Chalk up and work a bouldering wall in a gym that's been sending Asheville climbers for over 25 years, no rope required.
adventure.bonus: Try a route one grade harder than your usual

adventure.title: Book a Court at Aston Park Tennis Center
adventure.description: Volley on the same clay and hard courts that have hosted professional tournaments at Asheville's historic downtown tennis facility.
adventure.bonus: Play a tiebreak for bragging rights

adventure.title: Play Sand Volleyball on Highland Brewing's Meadow
adventure.description: Serve up a pickup match on a sand court set in a 40-acre hilltop meadow, with a cold pint waiting at the taproom after.
adventure.bonus: Recruit two strangers into your next game

foodie.title: Pair Sours with Wood-Fired Food at Wicked Weed Funkatorium
foodie.description: Work through a flight of barrel-aged sour beers in the East Coast's first dedicated sour taproom, paired with German-style beer garden fare.
foodie.bonus: Pick the sourest beer on the flight list first

foodie.title: Grab a Napoleon and Espresso at Old Europe Pastries
foodie.description: Pick a hand-built torte from the case at Asheville's oldest coffee shop and eat it at a marble table that's seen decades of regulars.
foodie.bonus: Order the pastry whose name you can't translate

foodie.title: Order Steak Frites at The Bull and Beggar
foodie.description: Sit under exposed brick in a converted RAD warehouse and dig into James Beard-nominated French bistro fare with an oyster or two on the side.
foodie.bonus: Order a dish you can't pronounce off the menu

foodie.title: Order a Wood-Fired Pie at All Souls Pizza in RAD
foodie.description: Watch a blistered, char-edged pizza come out of the wood oven at a River Arts District spot that treats toppings like a farmers market haul.
foodie.bonus: Order a pizza topping you'd never pick at home

foodie.title: Order the Sloppy Jai at Chai Pani
foodie.description: Dig into James Beard-winning Indian street food, loud and fast and dripping with chutney, at one of downtown's busiest tables.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server to pick your order for you

foodie.title: Tour the Bean-to-Bar Line at French Broad Chocolate Factory
foodie.description: Watch cacao beans get roasted, cracked, and stone-ground into bars at the working chocolate factory, then taste it fresh off the line.
foodie.bonus: Ask a staffer which batch is fresh today

foodie.title: Brunch on Biscuits at Tupelo Honey Downtown
foodie.description: Pile into a biscuit the size of your fist, drenched in blackberry ginger jam, at the flagship Southern kitchen across from Pritchard Park.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish with the strangest name on the menu

foodie.title: Eat a Farm-Sourced Dinner at Homegrown
foodie.description: Trust the kitchen at this scratch-made Merrimon Avenue spot to build a plate around whatever local farms delivered that morning.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server what came in fresh today

foodie.title: Build a Scoop Flight at The Hop Ice Cream Cafe
foodie.description: Stack a cup with rotating small-batch flavors, from bourbon butter pecan to vegan sorbet, made fresh since 1978.
foodie.bonus: Pick the weirdest flavor on the board

foodie.title: Feast on Jamón Ibérico at Cúrate
foodie.description: Watch a leg of hand-carved Ibérico ham disappear plate by plate while working through a James Beard-winning Spanish tapas menu and a serious sherry list.
foodie.bonus: Order the one tapa you've genuinely never heard of

foodie.title: Split a Flight of Truffles at French Broad Chocolate Lounge
foodie.description: Sink a fork into a molten chocolate cake or work through a tasting flight of single-origin truffles in a dim, velvet-couched downtown lounge.
foodie.bonus: Order the one truffle flavor you can't pronounce

foodie.title: Sample Global Tacos at White Duck Taco Shop
foodie.description: Work through a menu of Korean bulgogi, mahi mahi, and duck confit tacos that treat the tortilla like a passport.
foodie.bonus: Order the taco with the ingredient you can't identify
